description: §18.0.1 (amended S479) — a block `<match>` that omits `for=` over an `on=` the compiler cannot prove to be of ONE enum type (a choice between two enums) is E-MATCH-FOR-REQUIRED: name the enum with `for=Type`.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 4
rationale: §18.0.1: "`for=` MAY be omitted when `on=` is provably of one enum type"; "A `<match>` that omits `for=` where it stays required SHALL be … **`E-MATCH-FOR-REQUIRED`** when the compiler cannot prove the type of `on=` to be one enum type".
